testimonials.text: Thank you for providing such a well-structured and impactful course. It highlights critical challenges like delayed burn care and multi-organ complications that we face in conflict zones.
Excellent course, it presents the patient with didactic clinical cases.
Excellent course. Thanks for providing practical content on burns.

The most interesting aspect of the course was learning how burn injuries are managed beyond the acute phase, particularly the principles of scar management and reconstructive surgery. I found the decision-making around contracture release, skin grafting, flap selection, splinting, and reconstruction of difficult areas such as the eyelids, neck, and scalp especially valuable.
Excellent course with clear principles and high clinical relevance. Very valuable for building a solid foundation in burn reconstruction.
